name: obsidian-vault-manager
description: Obsidian vault knowledge management plugin (v4): three-skill layout (capture / note / audit) for a minimal second-brain workflow. capture saves raw input to inbox/ with URL metadata enrichment (source/url/title via Defuddle title extraction). note creates evergreen notes and decision records in notes/. audit scans for 5 structural error types (E1-E5). Two agents: vault-knowledge-manager (orchestrator) and vault-file-organizer (mechanical moves). type-optin: only files with a type: field are managed. Reusable shell primitives (ovm-primitives.sh) for frontmatter scanning, wikilink extraction, and audit-state tracking. Includes web-clipper-template reference for Obsidian Web Clipper integration.
